sources.title: NeurIPS Poster Leak-CURBER: A Leakage-Controlled Multimodal Evaluation ...
sources.snippet: Leak-CURBER standardizes data from 10 biochemical databases and curates datasets with multimodal inputs, metrics, and leakage-controlled splits for 4 tasks. The benchmark comprises 10 subtasks: prediction of reaction outcomes (2), enzyme function (2), kinetic parameters (3), and protein-ligand binding (3).
